readerCopy.body: Something can still touch a nerve without taking over the rest of the day. When the Moon trines Chiron, care and sensitivity reinforce each other, making an old emotional reaction easier to recognize before it decides everything that happens next. Feeling left out, criticized, overlooked, or reminded of an earlier disappointment can remain true without consuming the whole schedule. The feeling matters and the rest of life can continue beside it.
